used_as: typed CAPOREPARTO card; paper clock hands drawn per frame from the fixture clock; scissor-cut bites in the real apple cut-out; jaw-substitution drawings re-pinned from the real heads; the typed 'A' label and the one-line staging disclosure on the opening (0-2.4 s); the rule-modeler's schedule-strip slate (35-37 s: typed cards on a light box, Luciana's strip slides 3 minutes) with the same disclosure at its foot; the retouch of the Delano doorway (now covered by the foreman throughout); the hard hat and legs of the front foreman photograph collaged onto the back photograph; per-piece levels/gamma, contact shadows, camera moves.
